content: Karan Joshi from Safe Step Insurance emailed Aditi Mahajan to confirm the successful upgrade of her Health Plus Plus policy (HP-PLUS-PLUS-2026-00123) and the activation of the auto-debit arrangement starting October 5, 2026. The email details the policy's ₹12 Lakhs sum insured, ₹12,480 annual premium, unchanged ₹5,000 deductible, and new coverage highlights, while providing the policy schedule and terms via an attached PDF.

action_items: Review the attached policy schedule, terms and conditions, and auto-debit mandate confirmation
